verdict.rationale: Rippling documents in-product comparison of the current pay run against previous runs to catch discrepancies before approval, plus role-based approval controls, and it offers general platform APIs, developer docs and a sandbox. Nothing shows that payroll preview or anomaly data is exposed through the API, so an agent-driven workflow is not evidenced. Missing for 10: a documented API endpoint for payroll-run preview, API access to discrepancy/anomaly results, evidence of an agent or AI workflow over pay runs, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
